name: Vrak Blade Disciple (CR 1/2)
body:
VRAK BLADE DISCIPLE
CR 1/2

This humanoid looks somewhat like a bald, yellow-skinned half-orc with a ring of short horns coming out of its head in a ring around its head, arranged somewhat like a crown. Its face and arms are covered in red and black tattoos. It holds a shimmering purple blade composed of dull light.

XP 200
Vrak soulknife 1
N Medium humanoid (psionic, vrak)
Init +2; Senses Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 armor)
hp 13 (1d10+2+1)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +4
Defensive Abilities burst of ferocity (1/day)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mindblade +4 (1d8+3, 19-20/×2)
Ranged mindblade +4 (1d8+2, 19-20/×2, range incr. 15 ft.)

Psi-Like Abilities (ML 1st; concentration +3)

1/day—biofeedback

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +2; CMD 14
Feats Fast HealerAPG, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (mindblade), Wild Talent
Skills Acrobatics +6, Autohypnosis +6, Perception +6, Stealth +6
Languages Common, Vrak
SQ form mind blade (move action), psionics (2 pp), shape mind blade, throw mind blade, weapon familiarity
Gear NPC gear (leather armor, other gear)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Burst of Ferocity (Ex)

Once per day, when a vrak is brought below 0 hit points but not killed, they can fight on for 1 more round as if disabled. At the end of their next turn, unless brought to above 0 hit points, the vrak immediately falls unconscious and begins dying.

ABOUT

Vraks tend to be reserved with their emotions and focused on the task at hand. This is especially true of vrak blade disciples, who are dedicated to the art of the mindblade above all else. To them, combat is an art—a mental discipline to be studied and perfected.

Galactic Legions, Vol. 2: In the Shadow of the Empire. 2026, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author. Bryan Mangum.
